## Overview

Mentorloop sells cloud software for running mentoring programmes. It is relevant to Cairn as a competitor to the mentorship pack (FR-049) and as evidence of what employer buyers expect and pay. It offers Australian hosting [WEB-15-C2].

**Confidence**: Medium (4 sourced data points) | **Last Researched**: 2026-10-03

## Products & Services

- **Mentorloop Pro**: simpler programmes; unlimited matches, goal setting, video and chat, sentiment tracking, activity monitoring, live dashboards [WEB-15-C1]
- **Mentorloop Enterprise**: adds "1-1 support by mentoring experts," SSO, integrations, customisation and bespoke matching [WEB-15-C1]
- **Integrations**: SSO with Microsoft Azure Active Directory and Okta; HRIS and CRM (Salesforce, SAP SuccessFactors, BambooHR, Oracle); calendars; Slack; Zoom and Teams [WEB-15-C3]

## Pricing Model

Subscription. Pro is "Starting from $299/mo"; Enterprise is by quote [WEB-15-C1]. The page does not state the currency. ARC-001-RSCH-v1.0 notes that this entry price sits far below the SOBC's illustrative annual contract values.

## Strengths

- Australian hosting option [WEB-15-C2]
- Mature employer integrations (SSO, HRIS) [WEB-15-C3]
- Published entry price

## Weaknesses

- The pricing page lists UK-oriented assurance (Cyber Essentials, GDPR, ICO registration) [WEB-15-C3]; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is not stated there (unconfirmed, not absent)
- Activity monitoring and sentiment tracking for programme owners differ from Cairn's aggregate-only, describe-never-evaluate position (P4, P5, BR-009)
